sentence: عِنْدِي email مِن الشُّغِل لَازِم أَرُدّ عَلِيه
raw: عندي email من الشغل لازم أرد عليه
ipa: ˈʕindiː imeːl ˈmin ˈaʃʃuɣil ˈlaːzim ʔaˈrudd ʕaˈliːh
gloss_en: I have an email from work I must reply to
notes: [tech] email→imeːl (/eː/ mid-long loan vowel, ar-PS inventory; almbark2015 §1.1). ʕindi 'I have', iš-šuɣil 'work' (cowell1964). table: Levantine (Al-Saidat 2011; Cowell 1964)

sentence: اشْتَرَيْت laptop جْدِيد بَسّ بَطَّل يِشْتَغِل
raw: اشتريت laptop جديد بس بطل يشتغل
ipa: iʃtaˈreːt labtub ˈʒdiːd ˈbass ˈbɑtˤtˤɑl ˈjiʃtaɣil
gloss_en: I bought a new laptop but it stopped working
notes: [tech] laptop→labtub (/p/→[b], the Levantine nativisation delta; Al-Saidat 2011). baṭṭal 'stopped' + b-less imperfect yištaɣil (cowell1964). table: Levantine (Al-Saidat 2011; Cowell 1964)

gloss_en: there is a broken printer we must fix
notes: [tech] printer→brintar (initial /p/→[b]; Al-Saidat 2011). fī existential, xarbān 'broken', n-imperfect nṣalḥu (cowell1964). table: Levantine (Al-Saidat 2011; Cowell 1964)

sentence: شُفِت video كْتِير حِلُو عَ الْفَيْسْبُوك
raw: شفت video كتير حلو ع الفيسبوك
ipa: ˈʃufit fidiu ˈktiːr ˈħiluː ˈʕa lfeˈːsbuːk
gloss_en: I saw a very nice video on Facebook
notes: [tech] video→fidiu (/v/→[f]; ar-PS has no /v/; almbark2015). ktīr 'very' + ḥilu 'nice', ʕa proclitic (cowell1964). table: Levantine (Al-Saidat 2011; Cowell 1964)

gloss_en: I forgot the password of the email
notes: [tech] password→baswuːrd (/p/→[b], medial embed; Al-Saidat 2011). tāʕ 'of' Palestinian genitive exponent (cowell1964; fadda2016). table: Levantine (Al-Saidat 2011; Cowell 1964)

gloss_en: I lost the charger of the mobile
notes: [automotive] charger→ʃaːrdʒar (/tʃ/→[ʃ], the Levantine delta; Al-Saidat 2011; ǧīm loan [dʒ]). ḍāʕ minni 'I lost' (cowell1964). table: Levantine (Al-Saidat 2011; Cowell 1964)

gloss_en: I think this shop is expensive
notes: [opinion] think→θink (interdental /θ/ RETAINED in the loan vs Cairene [t]; almbark2015 keeps /θ/). hāda demonstrative, ɣāli 'expensive' (cowell1964). table: Levantine (Al-Saidat 2011; Cowell 1964)

gloss_en: I spoke with the company manager yesterday
notes: [work] manager→manadʒar (ǧīm kept [dʒ] in the loan vs Cairene [manaɡar]; Watson 2002). ḥakēt 'I spoke', mbāriḥ 'yesterday' (cowell1964). table: Levantine (Al-Saidat 2011; Cowell 1964)

gloss_en: I have an important meeting tomorrow morning
notes: [work] meeting→miːtinɡ (needs final /ɡ/, which ar-PS declares). bukra ṣ-ṣubiḥ 'tomorrow morning' (cowell1964). table: Levantine (Al-Saidat 2011; Cowell 1964)

gloss_en: I took the car to the garage
notes: [automotive] garage→ɡaːradʒ (/ɡ/ + ǧīm [dʒ], both in ar-PS inventory). waddēt 'I took', ʕa proclitic (cowell1964). table: Levantine (Al-Saidat 2011; Cowell 1964)

sentence: delivery بْيُوصَل بُكْرَا إِنْ شَاءَ الله
raw: delivery بيوصل بكرا إن شاء الله
ipa: dilifari ˈbjuːsˤɑl ˈbukraː ˈʔin ˈʃaːʔa ˈallah
gloss_en: the delivery arrives tomorrow, God willing
notes: [commerce] delivery→dilifari (/v/→[f]; initial embed). b-imperfect byūṣal (cowell1964). table: Levantine (Al-Saidat 2011; Cowell 1964)

gloss_en: I paid the bill in cash, not by card
notes: [commerce] cash→kaʃ (final embed). dafaʕit 'I paid', miš predicate negation (cowell1964). table: Levantine (Al-Saidat 2011; Cowell 1964)

gloss_en: I took the microbus into town
notes: [transport] Arabic-script loan sirfīs 'service/shared taxi', attested Palestinian [sirˈfiːs] (/v/→[f] integrated; cowell1964); pipeline reads the native graphemes → matches attested. table: Levantine (Al-Saidat 2011; Cowell 1964)

gloss_en: I got a flat tyre on the road
notes: [automotive] Arabic-script loan banšar 'puncture/flat' (<Eng. puncture), attested Levantine/Palestinian [ˈbanʃar]; pipeline reads the native graphemes → matches attested. table: Levantine (Al-Saidat 2011; Cowell 1964)

gloss_en: the car is automatic, not manual
notes: [automotive] loan ōtōmātīk; attested colloquial [ʔotomaˈtiːk] with /oː/ for و; pipeline reads و as /uː/ → 'assaˈjjaːra ʔuːtuːmaˈːtiːk ˈmiʃ ˈʕaːdiː' (WRONG). table: Levantine (Al-Saidat 2011; Cowell 1964)

gloss_en: I lost my mobile in the market
notes: [tech] loan mōbāyil; attested [moˈbaːjil] with /oː/ for و; pipeline reads و as /uː/ → 'ˈdˤɑːʕ ˈminniː lmuˈːbaːjil biˈlssuːʔ' (WRONG). urban qāf→[ʔ] in as-sūʔ (cotter2016). table: Levantine (Al-Saidat 2011; Cowell 1964)

gloss_en: the new television is very big
notes: [tech] loan tilifizyōn; attested [tilifizˈjoːn] with /oː/ for يون; pipeline reads و as /uː/ → 'attilifiˈzjuːn aˈlʒdiːd ˈkbiːr ˈktiːr' (WRONG). ǧīm [ʒ] urban in il-ʒdīd (almbark2015). table: Levantine (Al-Saidat 2011; Cowell 1964)

gloss_en: how are you? fine, thank God
notes: [arabizi] 3arabi spelling of شُو أَخْبَارَك؟ الْحَمْدِ لله تَمَام (5=/x/, 7=/ħ/); pipeline has no Arabizi path → hand-derived from the urban Palestinian reading (cowell1964). table: Levantine (Al-Saidat 2011; Cowell 1964)

ipa: ˈʔanaː ˈraħ ʔaˈruːħ ˈʕa ˈraːm ˈallah ˈbukra
gloss_en: I'll go to Ramallah tomorrow
notes: [arabizi] spelling of أَنَا رَح أَرُوح عَ رَام الله بُكْرَة (7=/ħ/, 3=/ʕ/); raḥ future particle, ʕa proclitic (cowell1964); pipeline has no Arabizi path → hand-derived. table: Levantine (Al-Saidat 2011; Cowell 1964)

gloss_en: what time is it now?
notes: [arabizi] spelling of قَدِّيش السَّاعَة هَلَّق؟ (2=/ʔ/ urban qāf, 3=/ʕ/); ʔaddēš 'how much/what', hallaʔ 'now' — distinctively Palestinian (cotter2016; cowell1964); pipeline has no Arabizi path → hand-derived. table: Levantine (Al-Saidat 2011; Cowell 1964)
